about.en: RWUSD is a Binance Earn yield product whose returns are benchmarked against US Treasury yields and generated by Binance's institutional strategies, including tokenized Treasury and other fixed-income products. It is subscribed with stablecoins on a 1:1 basis and redeemable for USDC on a 1:1 basis, and Binance states that it is a record of subscribed assets and accrued rewards held with Binance only, and not a stablecoin, security, fund, tokenized real-world asset or on-chain asset. It trades on Binance spot but supports no deposits or withdrawals.
